entry.name: fluid.bufthreaddemo~
entry.digest: A Tutorial Object to Experiment with Multithreading in FluidBuf* Objects
entry.description: Implements a tutorial object to illustrate and experiment with the behaviour of the FluidBuf* objects. To simulate their behaviour in various blocking modes, the object after waiting for time milliseconds, return its delay length as a float writen at index [0] of the specified destination buffer.
